questions.question: Discuss the moral lessons Tolstoy aims to convey through the story "The Three Questions."
questions.solution_html:
• Ans: about a king seeking answers to three questions: What is the right time to do something? Who
  • is the most important person to listen to? What is the most important thing to do? - The king sets
  • out on a journey to find the answers and meets three different people along the way- Each person
  • provides him with a different answer to his questions, but he is not satisfied- In the end, through the
  • interaction with hermit and wounded man the king learns that the most important time is the
  • present moment, the most important person is the one you are with, and the most important action
  • is to do good for others –moral : focus on the present and not worry about the past or future- Three
  • Questions serves as a template for a meaningful life.
questions.final_answer: Questions serves as a template for a meaningful life
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) Regular Exam Sem 1, Nov 2024
